title: Martial Ep. 4.44
author: Ancient
content:
4. Martial Epigram 4.44

Observe Vesuvius.  Not long ago it was covered with the grapevine's green shade, and 
a famous grape wet, nay drowned the vats here.  Bacchus loved the shoulders of this 
mountain more than the hills of Nysa [his birthplace], satyrs used to join their dances 
here.  Here was a haunt of Venus, more pleasant than Lacedaemon to her, here was a 
place where Hercules left his name.  It all lies buried by flames and mournful ash.  
Even the gods regret that their powers extended to this.
